dc:description: One source-specific saved sensitivity row, identified by its original ordered scenario/degree/role keys.
dc:title: Employment sensitivities
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: source_key: Ordered values of each primary source key.; transition_values: joint_state_unchanged_n,joint_state_changed_n,pct_observed_joint_state_changed,research_score_changed_n,clinical_score_changed_n,unscored_both_n; outside_values: n,pct_subset,pct_observed_degree; bases: observed_n,paired_scored_n OR subset_n,observed_degree_n by source; definition_label: sensitivity_definition_bases.definition_label via degree_group+definition
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
